# Embedding Emitter

The embedding emitter function processes and emits embeddings for dirty entities in a given repository. It handles entities left pending due to failures and ensures that unchanged embeddings are not recompilied, optimizing the embedding process.

- `knowledge_compiler/retrieval/embed.py` — `knowledge_compiler.retrieval.embed.emit_embeddings`
